The invitation to the Ceremony of Chaos
is delivered every 15 minutes between 20:00 and 24:00
every Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.
You can request to participate through this invitation.
Only the chosen will stand on the battleground.
Up to 18 warriors can battle in a battleground.
If you are lucky, you will be the only one sent to the battleground.
That is, you can be the winner without any fighting.
The battle lasts 5 minutes, or until only one challenger stands.
If several challengers remain alive at the end of the match, the one with the highest number of kills will be the winner.
The winner will be given
up to 5 Mysterious Boxes,
the victory reward, and the Mark of Battle.
The Mark of Battle can be exchanged for another reward.
Each cycle lasts a month, and for each cycle, the one with the greatest number of Marks of Battle
will be the winner, the Greatest Warrior.
If two or more challengers have the same number of Marks of Battle,
that cycle has no winner.
